name: 曹筱玥
objective:
本課程之目標在於執行互動設計為主，互動媒體與互動藝術為輔之相關專題設計，進行從企劃 - 設計 - 實作等一連串的設計流程，藉由創意企劃、腳本設計、構想展開以及設計雛形之製作，學生可彼此交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的體驗，並具備研究、分析、實作之能力。本所以結合電子資訊、機電、人文、設計與藝術等各領域的學生，以整合培育互動媒體設計專業人才，因此，本課程之另一主要學習目標為建構一多元領域交互學習的環境，以專題導向式為學習模式，可分別組合具設計、藝術、資訊、機電等專長的學生，協同完成互動媒體設計專題的設計創作。教學將以課堂講授、分組作業、設計發表以及專題實作為主，並以報告、分組討論與發表以及實作作品為評量方式。
This course focuses on interactive-design–oriented project development, complemented by interactive media and interactive art. Students engage in a complete design process from planning and design to implementation through creative proposals, script development, concept exploration, and prototype production. Emphasis is placed on interdisciplinary collaboration, bringing together students from fields such as design, art, information technology, mechatronics, and the humanities to collaboratively develop interactive media design projects using a project-based learning approach. The course aims to cultivate students’ abilities in research, analysis, and practical implementation through lectures, group work, presentations, and project-based practice, with evaluation based on reports, discussions, presentations, and completed works.
